prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one exceptionally art-directed landscape 3:2 brand identity concept board for PERRY, a Mac companion that sees your screen, points and draws to teach you, and can perform tasks. This is branding exploration ONLY, no website or app dashboard. Think a world-class experimental identity studio presenting an original, ownable visual system, not a stock tech branding template. The product name must remain "perry" spelled p-e-r-r-y. Direction name is a small secondary caption, not the brand. Give 55% of the composition to a stunning signature mark or brand image, and compose the remaining space with a beautifully kerned custom wordmark, a flat one-color silhouette version of exactly the same mark, one carefully crafted macOS app icon, a small simplified menu-bar glyph, and four solid palette swatches with exact hex labels. Include small repeated versions to reveal tiny-scale viability. Present a coherent authored board with intentional negative space and very few words; do not cram. Crisp graphic edges, impeccable typography. Render a fully opaque image, fill entire canvas edge to edge. No water droplet, leaf, generic sparkle, brain, orbit, gradient background wash, generic infinity knot, generic AI chatbot face, merchandise, stationery, business cards, stock mockups, fake awards, or random filler copy. No illegible microtext. All manifestations must use one consistent mark geometry. Output finished presentation image. DIRECTION: "Parallax". A provocative optical intelligence identity. Solid deep oxblood #310C21 ground, frost cyan #B7F4ED signature color, porcelain #F6F3ED ink, small coral #FF654F accent. Invent an asymmetric optical P: two nested thick crescent-like apertures, open on one side, with an offset rectangular pupil cutout; the silhouette should read as a lowercase p and a watchful optical instrument at once, absolutely not a conventional eyeball or camera lens. Construct from 2-3 clear bold shapes, not complex petals. Main mark rendered as a precise monumental optical-glass sculpture with oxblood absorption and pale cyan cut edges, a controlled refracted duplication THROUGH the sculpture only, gorgeous macro optical realism on a flat burgundy field. Make the mark seem to perceive the typography behind it. The small flat mark must retain exactly the same silhouette with no optical effects. Wordmark custom lowercase broad humanist grotesk with very distinctive aperture cuts related to the symbol, porcelain. Tension between strange optical object and rigorous graphic typography. Palette is dominated by oxblood, not black. No glowing environment, no neon, no purple wash, no shiny blob. The source of the spectacle is refraction and a memorable graphic silhouette. Show on the app icon as flat cyan symbol on oxblood with one restrained polished cut edge.
